1.ItemDes: Small, inconspicuous crystal shards that can briefly charge up heroes while a Chrono Core remains unrepaired. Used to determine faction advantages during the Conflict Phase. Obtainable via exploration.
1.ExploreItemDes: Used to determine faction advantages during the Conflict Phase.

2.ItemDes: A material scattered across the Cradle of Truth, used to repair damaged Chrono Cores. Obtainable via exploration.

3.ItemDes: A loose page from a lost diary, which might contain unknown secrets.

4.ItemDes: Pure crystals imbued with the very essence of energy itself. Collect a certain number to yield immense power. Used to determine the final winner. They are produced when your faction destroys enemy Chrono Cores, and can also be obtained by defeating monsters.

5.ItemDes: You can boost your Battle Will by challenging your opponent in battlefields. The side with the higher Battle Will in a battlefield will win the battle upon calculation of their results.
